parts.title: Part A. Reservation terms: imported puppies

clauses.heading: A1. Who these terms are between
paras: These terms apply when you reserve an imported puppy from Curious Tails Pte Ltd (UEN 202420075D), trading as Curious Tails, an AVS-licensed pet shop (licence AS24J00046) at 2 Balestier Road #01-701, Singapore 320002 ("we", "us"). They apply to every puppy we import to order for you: puppies listed as "Available for reservation · Imported" and puppies listed as "In Australia · Reserve". Puppies already in our shop are sold on our standard shop terms, shown on each puppy's page.

clauses.heading: A2. What a reservation is
paras: This puppy is not in Singapore and is not yet owned by us. It is with a breeder overseas. It is available for reservation and will be imported for you if you reserve it.

We confirm with the breeder that this puppy is still available before you pay anything, normally within 48 hours of your message. A listing on our website is an invitation to enquire, not an offer to sell. No contract exists, and you owe nothing, until we send you a written reservation confirmation and you pay the deposit.

Your reservation confirmation identifies the puppy by our reference number, sex and colour, and by its microchip number. It also gives the name of the puppy's breeder, the price, the deposit, the balance, the estimated arrival date and the month it falls in, and the version of these terms.

clauses.heading: A3. Price
paras: The price in your reservation confirmation is all-in, delivered to your door in Singapore, and it is fixed from the date of that confirmation. No import, flight, crate, veterinary certification or clearance fees are added later, even if our own costs go up.

The price includes: the AVS import licence; the veterinary checks and health certificate needed for export; the flight to Singapore; AVS clearance at Changi; home delivery and setup; the 30+ item starter kit; a free first training lesson with an AVS-certified trainer; ongoing WhatsApp support; and the puppy's first Singapore dog licence.

clauses.heading: A4. Deposit and balance
paras: 4.1 To reserve, you pay a deposit of 50% of the price by PayNow or bank transfer, after we have confirmed availability. We send your written reservation confirmation within 1 business day of receiving the deposit. We pay the breeder only after your deposit has cleared.

4.2 The remaining 50% (the balance) is due before the puppy flies, after we have sent you written confirmation of the booked flight, the puppy's pre-export vet check, and copies of its vaccination, worming and microchip records.

4.3 If the balance is not paid within 7 days after we send that confirmation, we will remind you in writing. If it is still unpaid 3 business days after the reminder, we may cancel the reservation, and clause 5.3 applies as if you had cancelled.

clauses.heading: A5. If you cancel
paras: 5.1 You may cancel at any time by telling us in writing. A WhatsApp message counts.
5.2 If you cancel before we have paid the breeder: we refund your deposit within 7 business days, less a fixed administration fee of S$250 for the work we have done on your reservation.

5.3 If you cancel after we have paid the breeder or booked the flight, we refund what you have paid less the costs we have actually incurred and cannot recover, such as the price paid to the breeder, a non-refundable flight or agent fee, and veterinary certification already done. We will show you these costs with receipts, and the deduction will never be more than the amount you have paid. If we later sell or rehome the puppy and recover any of those costs, we refund that amount to you within 7 business days of receiving it.

5.4 Instead of cancelling, you can move everything you have paid to another puppy, at no cost, at any time before your puppy departs for Singapore. The new puppy can be another imported puppy or one already in our shop. If it costs less, we refund the difference within 7 business days; if it costs more, you pay the difference. We send you a new written reservation confirmation, and if the new puppy is already in our shop, our standard shop terms apply to it.
5.5 Cancelling under clause 6 (import cannot go ahead) or under the delay clause in Part B is never treated as cancelling under this clause.

clauses.heading: A6. If the import cannot go ahead
paras: 6.1 This clause applies if the import cannot go ahead for any reason that is not your fault, including: the breeder sells to someone else or withdraws, the puppy fails its vet check or a vet advises it is unfit to fly, AVS refuses the licence, the puppy is refused entry at Changi, an airline embargo, a breed-rule change, or the puppy dies, is injured or falls seriously ill before it is handed over to you. In any of these cases, we refund everything you have paid. The refund is in full, with no deductions, and is paid within 7 business days. If you prefer, you can move it to another puppy instead.
6.2 We will tell you within 1 business day of learning that the import cannot go ahead.
6.3 We will not require you to accept a different puppy, and offering one does not delay your refund.

clauses.heading: A7. Health records and our 5-day promise
paras: 7.1 Before you pay the balance, we send you copies of the puppy's vaccination, worming and microchip records and its pre-export vet check. If those records show a health problem you were not told about before you reserved, you may cancel and clause 6 applies.

7.2 Our 5-day promise. If your puppy falls sick within the first 5 days of arriving home in Singapore, bring them back and we'll nurse them ourselves and pay the vet fees at our appointed vet. The 5 days start on the day your puppy arrives home, not on the day you reserve.
7.3 This promise is in addition to your rights under Singapore law, including the Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act, and does not limit them.

clauses.heading: A8. Risk and ownership
paras: 8.1 The puppy is at our risk until we hand it over to you at your home. Ownership passes to you at handover, once the price has been paid in full.
8.2 If anything happens to the puppy before handover, clause 6 applies.

clauses.heading: A9. Photos and descriptions
paras: 9.1 Listing photos and details come from the breeder and show the puppy when they were taken. Puppies grow and change quickly. Before you pay a deposit you may ask for fresh photos or a video, and we will request them from the breeder.

9.2 We describe coat colour, likely adult size and temperament in good faith, but we cannot guarantee them, especially for cross-breeds. We do not describe an imported puppy as pedigree or registered unless the breeder's registration papers are listed in your reservation confirmation.

clauses.heading: A10. What's included
paras: What's included: the same as every Curious Tails puppy, from the day your puppy arrives. The 30+ item starter kit ($500+ value), free home delivery and setup, a free first lesson with an AVS-certified trainer, and WhatsApp support for as long as you need it.
If you are not ready on arrival day, we board your puppy free, with lodging and food covered, for the first 14 days after arrival. After that, boarding costs S$30 a day.

clauses.heading: A11. Your personal data
paras: We use your details only to manage your reservation, the import and after-sale support, as set out in our privacy policy (curioustails.sg/privacy-policy/). We share them only with the parties needed to import your puppy: AVS, our pet-relocation agent, the airline and the exporting vet. Curious Tails Pte Ltd is the importer named on the AVS import licence, so we apply for it and deal with AVS for you.

clauses.heading: A12. Law and disputes
paras: These terms are governed by Singapore law. If we cannot resolve a complaint together, either of us may refer it to the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) for mediation or, where eligible, to the Small Claims Tribunals.

clauses.heading: B1. Estimated arrival
paras: Your reservation confirmation gives an estimated arrival date and the month it falls in. It is an estimate, not a fixed date. Puppies can fly to Singapore from 12 weeks old, and every import depends on AVS approval, the vet health certificate and an available flight.

Puppies fly at about 3 months old, so we work out the estimate from your puppy's date of birth: date of birth plus about 3 months. For example, if you reserve a puppy at 8 weeks old, it should arrive in about 4 weeks. At 6 weeks old, it should arrive in about 6 weeks.
If your puppy is already about 3 months old when you reserve, it flies once its paperwork and flight are ready, and your confirmation gives our estimate for that.
Once your confirmation is sent, the estimate in it does not change unless we tell you about a delay under B3. The 45-day and 90-day periods in B4 and B5 count from the end of the estimated month.

clauses.heading: B2. What can cause a delay
paras: Delays can be caused by: AVS or the authorities in the puppy's home country taking longer to issue a licence or certificate; a vet advising that the puppy should wait before flying; airline embargoes, cancellations or seasonal restrictions on carrying animals; disease-control or other government restrictions; and changes to import rules.

clauses.heading: B3. Keeping you informed
paras: We'll keep you updated at every step on WhatsApp. Within 2 business days of learning of anything likely to push arrival past the estimated month, we will tell you the reason and give you a revised estimate.

clauses.heading: B4. Your options if arrival is late
paras: If the puppy has not arrived by the last day of the estimated month, you may choose to keep waiting or to move your payment to another puppy. If it has not arrived within 45 days after the end of the estimated month, you may also cancel for a full refund of everything you have paid, at any time before the puppy departs for Singapore. We pay the refund within 7 business days. This applies whatever the cause of the delay.

clauses.heading: B5. Long-stop date
paras: If the puppy has not arrived within 90 days after the end of the estimated month, the reservation ends automatically and we refund everything you have paid, in full, within 7 business days, unless you have told us in writing that you want to keep waiting.

clauses.heading: B6. If the import cannot go ahead
paras: If your puppy can't come, clause 6 of the reservation terms applies and everything you have paid comes back to you.

clauses.heading: B7. Events outside our control
paras: We are not liable to pay compensation for a delay caused by events outside our reasonable control. This never affects your right to a refund under this Part or under clause 6.
